products.title: Ceiling Pendant Twisted Soft Round Lampshade
products.description: A modern 3D-printed pendant lampshade with a sleek twisted design that creates a warm, inviting glow. Lightweight (100 g), durable, and perfect for any contemporary space.

products.title: FlowForm Pendant
products.description: Inspired by flowing petals, the Twisted Bloom Pendant Lampshade brings a soft, modern elegance to any space. Precision 3D printed for a unique sculptural look that diffuses light beautifully. Lightweight (220 g), durable, and perfect for homes, cafés, or offices.

products.title: HexaLight Table Lamp
products.description: A modern 3D-printed table lamp featuring a refined geometric texture that casts a warm, cozy glow. Lightweight, durable, and designed to elevate bedrooms, living spaces, and workspaces.

products.title: Hemman Lampshade
products.description: 3D printed sculptural lampshade designed for IKEA HEMMA pendant light. Features smooth twisting rib geometry that diffuses light softly while creating a modern, elegant shadow pattern.

products.title: Curved lampshade with feet stand
products.description: A precision 3D printed curved lampshade with integrated feet stand, engineered for lightweight strength and smooth organic form. Designed for soft ambient lighting, its flowing structure diffuses light evenly while the elevated base ensures stability and a clean modern sculptural look.

products.title: Wave Light Bedside Lamp – Background Light
products.description: A wave-inspired bedside lamp, fully designed and 3D printed for a smooth organic form and lightweight structure. It produces a soft ambient background glow, creating a calm and modern atmosphere while showcasing precision-crafted layered design and sculptural elegance.

products.title: Beehive Pendant – Vase Mode Edition
products.description: A lightweight 3D printed pendant lampshade inspired by natural beehive structures. Designed in vase mode for a smooth, continuous form, it delivers a soft ambient glow while maintaining a minimal and organic aesthetic. Weight: 125g, making it efficient, elegant, and ideal for modern interior lighting.

products.title: The GeoHive Pendant
products.description:
Home Studio Crafted that Art meets tech with precise 3D printing.
Ambient Glow and Geometric pinholes cast a stunning, warm light pattern.

products.title: Korb Lampshade
products.description: A beautifully woven 3D-printed pendant lampshade with an intricate basket-like texture. The Korb Lampshade casts a warm, patterned glow perfect for cozy interiors, dining areas, or boutique spaces. Lightweight and durable, crafted with precision for a unique handmade look.

products.title: Low Poly Polygon Lamp
products.description: A striking 3D-printed pendant lampshade inspired by low-poly geometric design. Its faceted polygon structure creates a stunning interplay of light and shadow, adding a modern artistic touch to any room. Lightweight, durable, and perfect for contemporary interiors.

products.title: Mark Lamp
products.description: A sleek 3D-printed pendant lampshade with a modern sculptural silhouette. The Mark Lamp diffuses light softly, creating a warm ambiance perfect for dining rooms, hallways, or minimalist living spaces.

products.title: No Evil Trio
products.description: A playful 3D-printed decor set inspired by the classic 'See No Evil, Hear No Evil, Speak No Evil' motif. Perfect as a shelf accent, desk companion, or conversation starter. Lightweight and finely detailed.

products.title: Ola Lamp
products.description: Inspired by gentle ocean waves, the Ola Lamp features a flowing, undulating form that casts a soft rhythmic glow. A beautiful statement piece for coastal or contemporary interiors.

products.title: Organic Flower Vase
products.description: A nature-inspired 3D-printed vase with smooth organic curves and a sculptural form. Designed to hold fresh or dried flowers, it adds an elegant touch to any tabletop, shelf, or mantelpiece.

products.title: Ripple Lamp
products.description: A mesmerizing 3D-printed lampshade featuring concentric ripple textures that create a calming water-drop effect when illuminated. Ideal for bedrooms, lounges, or meditation spaces.

products.title: Sechseck Lamp
products.description: German for 'hexagon', the Sechseck Lamp showcases a bold hexagonal geometric design. Its sharp angles and clean lines create dramatic light patterns, perfect for modern and industrial-style interiors.

products.title: Semif Lamp
products.description: A semi-spherical 3D-printed pendant lamp with a clean, minimalist profile. The Semif Lamp provides even, diffused lighting and complements both Scandinavian and modern interior styles.

products.title: Twisted Table Lamp
products.description: A striking 3D-printed table lamp with a dynamic twisted spiral design. It serves as both a functional light source and an art piece, casting intricate shadows while adding sculptural elegance to desks, nightstands, or side tables.
